chunks: And there are some among the people who say: "We believe in God and the Last Day," yet they are not believers.
ai.seo_question: Who are the hypocrites mentioned in the Quran who say they believe but do not?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as the opening declaration of the *Munafiqun* (Hypocrites), establishing the archetype of those whose faith is merely a social mask. It underscores the critical distinction between *iman* (inner conviction) and *islam* (outward submission), a theme central to understanding the spiritual integrity of the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers during periods of political concealment (Taqiyyah).
